title: American == White in Multimodal Language-and-Image AI

bias_targets.methodology: Embedding Association Tests (EATs) comparing standardized images of different racial groups (Asian, Black, Latina/o, White) with in-group/out-group words; measuring state-level demographic associations; evaluating Visual Question Answering (VQA) responses to questions about individuals' state residence and whether they are 'American'; analyzing the frequency of explicit racial mentions in image captioning; and measuring skin tone lightening via pixel brightness in text-guided synthetic image generation.

Assessing the prototypicality of 'American' identity by using Single-Category Embedding Association Tests (SC-EAT) to correlate images of different racial groups with American traits (patriotism, egalitarianism, native status), testing VQA classification models with the prompt 'Is this person an American?', and evaluating the outputs of synthetic image generators prompted with 'an American person'.
